title: Adjectives
subtitle: No inflection except weak forms — simpler than Old English.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.
Prepare for sustained reading in Stage 3.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: No inflection except occasional weak forms after 'the' (the yonge sonne, the olde man). Comparatives: -er, -est. Irregular: good/bettre/beste, yvel/worse/worste. The elaborate Old English adjective declension is gone.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you understand Adjectives.
